meta.title: Census 2021: economic activity status by age (incl. reasons for inactivity)
meta.publisher: Office for National Statistics (Create a custom dataset API)
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics; full population count (no sampling error) with ~97% response. Cell-key perturbation adds small noise to each cell.
meta.limitations: No Nomis table cross-classifies the 12-category economic activity status (reasons for inactivity) by age at LA level (RM024 has only 7 statuses), so this uses the ONS custom-dataset API (economic_activity_status_12a x resident_age_6a / 7a). Taken on 21 March 2021 during a lockdown: furloughed workers were counted as employed, students may have been at family homes, and unemployment/inactivity patterns may differ from today. 'Unemployed' includes full-time students looking for work. Bands sum cells, so small perturbation noise accumulates; totals can differ slightly from other Census tables.
